cases.title: valid minimal credential id accepted
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns Ok; no FFI reached with invalid state

cases.title: valid nested credential id accepted
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns Ok; namespaced target stays within the 512-unit bound

cases.title: empty credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput; wrappers fail closed before FFI

cases.title: overlong credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput for any id longer than 240 bytes; never truncated or defaulted

cases.title: forged absolute credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput; absolute paths cannot become WinCred targets

cases.title: traversal credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput; dot/dot-dot/empty segments cannot escape the EliotGovernor namespace

cases.title: null credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput; interior NUL fails closed before wide conversion

cases.title: forged charset credential id rejected
cases.expectation: validate_credential_id returns InvalidInput; only ASCII alnum plus - _ . / are accepted

cases.title: wide-input target bound holds at the 240-byte edge
cases.expectation: 240-byte id validates Ok and its EliotGovernor/ namespaced target stays strictly below the 512-unit scan bound and the wide NUL bound

cases.title: invalid ids fail closed before WinCred FFI on every entry point
cases.expectation: credential_status/read/delete/enumerate/write each return InvalidInput for invalid ids without forming pointers or defaulting to missing

cases.title: real WinCred valid-absent and blob-bound behavior without mutation
cases.expectation: real CredReadW/CredDeleteW/CredEnumerateW for a unique valid-but-absent id return None/false/absent; empty and oversized writes return InvalidInput before CredWriteW; no credential is created, modified, or deleted

cases.title: fixture binds every credential-span unsafe site and names deferred families
cases.expectation: fixture lists all 19 credential-span sites with bounds and cases 1..12, and enumerates deferred families (oplock async, pipe/process, job/IOCP/spawn, notify/move, security/pipe-server) as not implemented in this wave

notes: Credential span only (lib.rs validate_credential_id through credential_delete_current_user). Other families are deferred residuals listed above, not implemented now.
Real code only: tests call the real public eliot-windows-ipc API on Windows; no mocks, no UB probes, no pointer forging.
Fail-closed everywhere: invalid or overlong input returns InvalidInput/InvalidData; enumeration counts and blob sizes are capped before any from_raw_parts view.
